visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene begins inside a dimly lit car at night. A young man with short black hair, wearing a green T-shirt, is in the driver's seat looking into the camera. He speaks while holding the steering wheel. A smartphone is mounted on the dashboard, displaying a chat interface. (2) The setting remains inside the car at night. Two men are shown; the driver in green and a passenger in a white T-shirt. They are eating skewers from a plastic bag, bringing the food to their mouths. The lighting is dark with some city lights passing outside the window. (3) The camera shifts to a view through the car's windshield during early dawn. The sky is a deep blue-grey. The car travels along a highway with green directional signs overhead. (4) Inside a brightly lit supermarket/convenience store. The main character in a white T-shirt is seen picking up multiple 6-packs of canned porridge from a shelf. His friend holds a massive stack of these packs, reaching up to his face. They are smiling and interacting with the camera. (5) Outdoor daytime. The car is parked on the side of a busy street. The man stands by the open rear hatch of a van/SUV, which is filled with stacks of canned food. He hands the cans out to a continuous stream of people walking by. The pedestrians wear red hats, backpacks, and some wear yellow vests. (6) A large crowd of pilgrims is walking down a street lined with residential buildings. A palanquin with a distinctive pink roof and yellow curtains is carried through the crowd by people in yellow uniforms. The man stands on the sidewalk with his hands pressed together in a prayer gesture. (7) Back inside the car during the day. The man is holding a long red ribbon with yellow text and a small yellow charm. He carefully hangs it on the car's rearview mirror. The lighting is bright natural daylight.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 好的各位今天呢拍完影片大概是凌晨2:23分. (2) [Subtitle]: 秉持著每一年呢 都要去白沙屯走一下. (3) [Subtitle]: 我想就是現在 這個奇怪的時間. (4) [Subtitle]: 5/5 2:24分在台南黃金海岸 Right now 祂現在在哪裡. (5) [Subtitle]: 祂在雲林 主要係媽祖好像五點就要起駕了. (6) [Subtitle]: 開去那邊剛好 大家都起床囉. (7) [Subtitle]: 慰勞一下這些走那麼遠的人 他們這樣走也走了一百七十幾公里了欸. (8) [Subtitle]: 大家應該沒吃早餐吧 那我就買個八寶粥吧. (9) [Subtitle]: 媽祖會保佑你 我們採購完畢60人份的早餐了. (10) [Subtitle]: 現在時間大概是5:40分 我們連自己的早餐都還沒吃欸. (11) [Subtitle]: 我們在這邊埋伏 啊不是埋伏啦 在這邊等待. (12) [Subtitle]: 現在應該是路線會像這樣子. (13) [Subtitle]: 好快 好快快沒了欸. (14) [Subtitle]: 每一年求的願望都是希望家人身體健康. (15) [Subtitle]: 只要這一年家人平安無事 我都會來陪走一小段還願. (16) [Subtitle]: 今年是第六年 比較忙 只能用這種方式 希望大家都能平平安安的. (17) [Subtitle]: 剛剛拿到的結緣品 很棒欸 感覺好好喔.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The video starts in a car interior at night, transitions to a highway, moves into a convenience store with shelves of products, and ends on a sunny urban street with residential houses and a large religious procession.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a male voice speaking in a friendly, conversational tone with moderate speed and standard pitch. There is a very low-frequency hum of a car engine idling. (2) As the scene cuts to the two men eating, the sound of plastic bags rustling (frictionRustleSFX) is prominent. A soft, sentimental pop BGM begins, featuring acoustic guitar strumming at a slow tempo (~70 BPM). (3) A digital click sound occurs as the scene transitions to the highway. The background noise shifts to high-frequency wind noise from driving. (4) Inside the store, the acoustic guitar BGM continues. There are distinct metallic clinking sounds as canned goods are picked up and stacked. (5) Upon reaching the outdoor procession, the audio environment becomes much more complex. There is a high-arousal mix of crowd chatter, people shouting greetings, and rhythmic metallic clanging from ceremonial gongs in the distance. (6) A sharp percussive sound (impactSFX) occurs as the van's hatch is closed. The man's voice is heard greeting pilgrims excitedly. (7) As the palanquin passes, the BGM swells into a more energetic, uplifting pop track with a stronger beat (~110 BPM). Traditional firecracker explosions and loud drumming dominate the foreground. (8) The final segment returns to the car interior where the sentimental BGM plays softly under the man's reflective narration. The sound of a ribbon being handled creates subtle rustling noises.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video documents the creator's yearly tradition of participating in the Baishatun Mazu Pilgrimage. It starts with his late-night decision and preparation, moves through the purchase of supplies for pilgrims, and culminates in the act of giving out food on the roadside as the palanquin passes. The content aims to share the spiritual fulfillment of the pilgrimage and the creator's personal wish for his family's health.
